product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides an AI-powered employee-experience platform for organizations, using employee surveys and people analytics to help leaders understand workforce experience and turn insights into action.
product_one_liner.notes: Perceptyx describes an AI-powered employee-experience platform that turns employee insight into action; the company description identifies employee surveys and people analytics as part of its offering.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing check reports that the company's pricing URL returned a 404 and that it had no pricing page; the homepage directs visitors to talk to an expert instead.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer-stories page presents case studies naming Sysco and Norton Healthcare. | named_customers.0: Sysco is named in a customer case-study title. | named_customers.1: Norton Healthcare is named in a customer case-study title.

employee_band.notes: The reported count is 399 employees as of June 2026, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company information states its headquarters is in Temecula, California. | hq_country: The company information identifies its headquarters as Temecula, California, which is in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The cited profile directly states that Perceptyx was founded in 2003.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists employee-experience, listening, research, product/company news and related people-focused topics, not at least two engineering posts about how the product is built. Under the stated criterion, this supports false.

public_docs.notes: Perceptyx provides a public developer portal with multiple API documentation articles, including introduction, authentication, rate limiting, response codes, survey data and exports.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists two open roles: Enterprise Sales Development Representative and VP, Strategic Expansion. Neither title is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI and Google for optional generative AI features; Perceptyx also says its core offering uses proprietary AI models.
model_provider.notes: Perceptyx's AI overview names OpenAI and Google as providers for optional generative AI features and separately says its core offering uses proprietary AI models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Perceptyx's security page names ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II. The answer lists those named certifications and omits other security authorizations not requested. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II.

A separate November 2019 $8 million Series A report concerns Cultivate, not Perceptyx, so it is excluded. | funding_date: The latest-round listing and dated announcement identify August 12, 2019, represented as 2019-08. | funding_amount_usd: The latest-round listing identifies the August 2019 Growth Equity round but masks the amount; the contemporaneous announcement describes the TCV investment without stating a dollar amount. The amount is therefore unknown.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified Perceptyx funding event is dated August 2019, well before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Sales Development Representative posting identifies a full-time role and includes an application section.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced the launch of Perceptyx Anywhere on September 29, 2026, within the six months before the specified date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mary Poppen's June 25, 2026 post says she joined Perceptyx earlier that month as Chief Customer Officer; the leadership page lists her in that role. This is within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.
